recentItems.title: NY family wakes up to find car crashed into living room
recentItems.description:
A Deer Park, New York couple is speaking out after a car crashed directly into their home while they slept. The family says they woke up to find the vehicle sitting inside their living room, just feet from their son's bedroom. Authorities arrested Matthew Troche, a 19-year-old Amityville man, who later appeared before a judge and pleaded not guilty. Authorities say Troche had slurred speech, smelled like cannabis and had cannabis products in the car.

recentItems.title: Nearly $20K stolen in NYC mosque thefts
recentItems.description:
Police say 48-year-old Nabil Kartah is wanted in connection with a pattern of thefts and hate crimes at mosques across New York City. Investigators say he targeted unattended belongings, stealing cash, credit cards, and making unauthorized purchases that totaled nearly $20,000 over the last two years. Authorities say incidents occurred in the Bronx, Brooklyn, Queens and Manhattan, and are asking the public for help locating him.

recentItems.title: Inside the NYPD’s BIGGEST cocaine bust in more than a decade
recentItems.description:
The NYPD says it has made its largest cocaine seizure in at least a decade, recovering roughly 580 pounds of cocaine worth an estimated $10 million. Investigators from multiple law enforcement agencies tracked a suspected drug operation for two weeks before making arrests and uncovering dozens of packages of cocaine, cash, and a firearm. The investigation remains ongoing, and authorities say additional arrests are expected.
